_comment: Project-local Claude Code settings for the AI-Prowler autonomous task runner. Scoped to THIS project only — does not modify your global ~/.claude/settings.json.
_command_note: v8.1.14: the hook command below is a fallback bare `python` invocation, shipped as-is by the installer. task_queue_automation.py's generate_mcp_config() and dry_run_check() both self-heal this to an absolute python.exe path (sys.executable) on whatever machine this actually runs on — see _ensure_hook_uses_absolute_python()'s docstring for why a build-time hardcoded path can't work here (every end user has Python installed somewhere different). This static fallback only matters in the brief window before that self-heal first runs.
_permission_note: The unattended runner passes --allowedTools 'mcp__ai-prowler__*' explicitly on the command line (see task_queue_automation.py build_wrapper_script_content) rather than relying on this file's permissions block, so scoping is visible and testable independent of local settings drift.
